probe: compaction engine resolution from the agent's OWN scoped context + observability entry points, against a REAL session
whatThisProves: the drive path is reachable: the engine resolves from the agent's own scoped context and answers instead of throwing
a null answer means 'no safely compactable range' — a recorded fact, not an error
the observability entry points (session.log / eventsSnapshot) are readable on a live Agent
whatThisDoesNotProve: a NON-NULL compaction and the durable compaction/start + compaction/end event pair: both need session CONTENT, which needs a provider key this environment does not have

credentialBoundary.note: recorded so the limit is auditable rather than asserted; the credentialed layer is owed to a later slot
